config.knob_cells: elasticity 0 and 1 run at c 0.12 only; elasticity 0.5 at both shares
config.lock: each wage earner moves c of the wages it received this round into its own account, after wages and before spending; each deposit returns whole to its owner hold rounds later at the same position; the account is the network's parked stock, owned by the node that paid in
config.mean_field: A44's MeanField, opened into its steps; forcing per round: reissue gap against the control at the injection node, then wages, then release minus deposit at the earners, then spending
config.stall: last 50 rounds' wages paid below 0.5 of the same seed's control
config.tangent_cells: every seed, elasticity and authority, hold 5 and never

criteria.detail: c = 0 reproduces the network bit for bit on seeds [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
criteria.name: A53-0  the lock off is the network: with c = 0 every history field and the generator state match bit for bit

criteria.detail: ledger closes on 100 cells, and a hold of 300 is the never-returned run
criteria.name: A53-1  the lock's ledger closes: holdings and accounts against claims and issuance, each deposit c of its earner's wage, each release its owner's deposit hold rounds earlier, a hold of 300 the never-returned run

criteria.detail: lock path tangent against the whole model at c = 1e-08 on 60 cells, largest class gap over wages paid 9.43e-08 (tolerance 1e-05)
criteria.name: A53-2  the lock's path tangent is the carrier's rule: against the whole model's finite difference, class by class, within the tolerance of A44-1

criteria.detail: 200 of 200 cell-seed rows, all finite, every ledger closed; 15 rows stalled against the control and not read as distribution
criteria.name: A53-3  the lock's readings are printed on every cell and seed: shares with and without the account, the account against Little, reissue per unit locked, circulation, the wage tail against the control

criteria.detail: 200 of 200 rows decomposed; rebuilt mean-field steps against A44's matrix, largest gap 0.0e+00; the reissue is an input taken from each cell's run, the mean field says where it lands
criteria.name: A53-4  the gap in the production share splits into the account stock and a circulation term, and the circulation term is read against A44's mean field driven by the cell's own deposits, releases and reissue
